name: EDD Helms Group, Inc.
summary: Edd Helms Group, Inc., headquartered in Sunrise, Florida, delivers a comprehensive array of services to commercial, industrial, and residential customers across the South Florida region. The company's offerings span several key areas: Electrical Services: This includes everything from routine residential electrical repairs to intricate commercial electrical installations. Data Communications: They specialize in the design, installation, and documentation of premise cabling infrastructure, crucial for modern local area network environments. HVAC and Home Technology: Edd Helms Group also provides air conditioning and advanced home technology services. Temporary Utilities: They serve as an independent contractor, supplying temporary utility services for major events like trade shows, conventions, and special gatherings. Marine Systems: Their expertise extends to the marine sector, where they design, install, and service marine air conditioning and refrigeration systems, in addition to selling over-the-counter marine AC parts from various manufacturers. Cellular Tower Management: Furthermore, the company handles site maintenance, management, emergency repairs, re-lamping, painting, erection, electrical work, and inspection services for cellular towers.
